description: DRAFTS a stake and returns a link only. This never signs anything and never sends anything: the link opens the NimBooks app with the stake panel pre-filled, and you check the amount and validator there and confirm in your own wallet. No validator is recommended, ranked or chosen for you, and there is no default validator. The link is the deliverable, exactly like create_payment_request: nothing is built, broadcast or queued here, and nothing is marked as staked. Notes explain what the app will do with the values, including a cap to the free balance and the 100 NIM first-stake minimum.

address.description: The staker account, used only to read the current delegation and liquid balance for notes. Optional; defaults to the server’s configured address.

amountNim.description: Amount in NIM, decimal, at most 5 decimals. An omitted or invalid amount is left out of the link with a note.

validator.description: A validator NQ address, or a validator name (exact, or a unique part of the name). There is no default validator.

name: draft_stake
title: Draft a stake link
